title: Remove clears the default on every dependent customer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, with no work orders, part sales, assets or contacts of its own.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, whose Bill Invoices To is saved as customer B.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, whose Bill Invoices To is also saved as customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer B's Edit Customer window.
  2. Click Delete.
  3. Click Delete in the Confirmation window.
  4. Click "Remove As Default Bill To".
  5. Click "Remove".
  6. Open customer A's page.
  7. Open customer C's page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer B's Edit Customer window opens.

Step 2:

  • A "Confirmation" window asks "Are you sure you want to delete this company?" with "Cancel" and "Delete".

Step 3:

  • The "Delete Customer" window names customer A and customer C.

Step 4:

  • The "Remove as default Bill To" window opens.

Step 5:

  • The defaults are removed and the delete Confirmation shows again.
  • Customer B is not deleted yet.

Step 6:

  • Customer A's card shows no "Bill Invoices To" line: it bills itself.

Step 7:

  • Customer C's card shows no "Bill Invoices To" line.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12314 (Story 12, Deleting a customer that pays for others)

  • S12-R5: “Confirming clears the saved default on every dependent customer; open work orders keep their Bill To.”
